params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $d=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-bridge-checkpoint-tests'; if(Test-Path $d){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d}; git clone --quiet --single-branch --branch heaven-bridge https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $d; python -m py_compile (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\worker.py') (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py'); python (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py'); $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d; exit $rc
